name: Five Card Draw
tagline: The classic: five cards, one draw, and plenty of room to bluff.

options.label: Draw four when keeping an ace

rulesSummary: Everyone antes, then gets five cards. Betting starts left of the dealer (no limit; the smallest bet is the ante).
If everyone checks, the cards are thrown in and the pot stays for the next deal — everyone antes again.
The draw: starting left of the dealer, each player still in discards up to three cards and gets replacements — or stands pat.
A second round of betting, begun by the player who opened, then the best five-card hand wins. Ties split the pot.
Options: jacks or better to open (no bet until someone holds a pair of jacks or better); draw four if you keep an ace.
